battle.name: 十日戰爭
battle.brief: 十日戰爭於1991年7月在斯洛維尼亞爆發，斯洛維尼亞地方防衛軍與南斯拉夫人民軍交戰，十日後斯洛維尼亞取得獨立。裝備方面，德國陸軍於1850年列裝線膛砲（Muzzle-loading field gun），屬當時野戰砲兵，用於火力支援。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛砲（Muzzle-loading field gun）是十九世紀中葉野戰砲兵的核心裝備，隸屬陸軍砲兵，負責隨軍支援步兵作戰，並以營、連等基層編制部署。

countries: 正式交戰的核心是斯洛維尼亞共和國與南斯拉夫人民軍（JNA）。1991年的正式國號仍是南斯拉夫社會主義聯邦共和國，聯邦軍的實際調度卻日益由塞爾維亞方面主導。第十四軍及若干直屬分隊從原駐區或鄰境進入，任務是解除地方防衛軍的武裝、接管兵營和軍械設施。斯洛維尼亞方面由地方防衛軍（TO）、共和國警察與各市鎮指揮部組成，事前並不是一支完整的常備軍。克羅埃西亞不是此戰的正式交戰盟邦，但其政府限制聯邦軍把斯洛維尼亞戰線的部隊與補給線自由轉用至克羅埃西亞前線，直接改變兵力部署。歐洲共同體只派觀察與協調人員，沒有加入任何一方作戰。
countriesEn: The formal core of the conflict was between the Republic of Slovenia and the Yugoslav People's Army, or JNA. The official state name in 1991 was still the Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia, although the federal military's actual direction was increasingly dominated by Serbia. Elements of the 14th Army Corps and several directly attached units entered from their peacetime stations or neighboring territory, with the task of disarming the Territorial Defence, or TO, and taking over barracks and military facilities. The Slovenian side consisted of the TO, the republican police, and municipal command posts, and it did not begin the war as a fully formed standing army. Croatia was not a formal allied belligerent in this war, but its government prevented the JNA from freely transferring troops and supply lines from the Slovenian front to the Croatian front, directly altering the distribution of forces. The European Community sent observers and coordinators but did not participate in combat on either side.
people: 斯洛維尼亞總統米蘭・庫揚（Milan Kučan）在六月廿五日宣布獨立後，批准地方防衛軍動員，並把是否全面投入戰爭的決定保留在政府層級。地方防衛軍指揮官亞內茲・舒斯特什奇（Janez Šušteršič）把平時的市鎮與區域編組迅速轉為旅團級作戰體系，維持防線、後備動員和地方指揮部的縱向聯繫。南斯拉夫人民軍參謀長韋利科・查奇奇（Veljko Čačić）代表聯邦軍統籌第十四軍等單位，企圖先以裝甲部隊奪取兵營、火砲與交通節點，再迫使地方防衛軍放下武器。克羅埃西亞總統弗蘭約・圖季曼（Franjo Tuđman）的政府同樣改變戰局；其部署限制了聯邦軍在斯洛維尼亞與克羅埃西亞之間調動，使查奇奇無法把整個第十四軍集中投入。各旅團長與連長在前線選擇側翼射擊、封鎖道路還是正面攻擊，才真正決定這些部署能否奏效。
peopleEn: After Slovenian President Milan Kučan declared independence on 25 June, he authorized the mobilization of the Territorial Defence and kept the decision to commit the country to full-scale war at the governmental level. TO commander Janez Šušteršič rapidly converted peacetime municipal and regional organizations into brigade-sized combat formations while preserving front lines, reserve mobilization, and vertical links with local command posts. Yugoslav People's Army Chief of Staff Veljko Čačić directed the 14th Army Corps and other federal formations, seeking to seize barracks, artillery, and transport nodes with armored forces before compelling the TO to disarm. The government of Croatian President Franjo Tuđman also altered the strategic situation: its deployments restricted JNA movements between Slovenia and Croatia and prevented Čačić from concentrating the entire corps in Slovenia. At the front, the choices made by brigade and company commanders regarding flanking fire, road closure, and frontal attacks determined whether these larger deployments would work.
kits: 七月七日初接觸時，聯邦軍可迅速投入的裝備包括M-84主戰坦克、BVP M-80裝甲運兵車、M-60P輪式裝甲車，以及152毫米M-84榴彈炮、130毫米M-30野戰炮、105毫米M-44榴彈炮與120毫米M-62迫擊炮；步兵主要使用Zastava M-70、M-76、M-77步槍及M-48／66步槍，並配備RPG-7、9K14 Malyutka與9K11 T-3反戰車武器，9K33 Osa防空飛彈則用於保護重要路段和裝甲集中地。斯洛維尼亞地方防衛軍最初能可靠使用的是步槍、輕機槍、CZ-75手槍、RPG-7及少量反戰車武器，其M-80等裝甲車和火砲須從占領的聯邦軍兵營、倉庫及前線繳獲物中補充。聯邦軍另有MiG-21偵察與戰鬥機、Mi-8直昇機投入或待命，但斯洛維尼亞早期缺乏成體系的空中監視、防空和航空維修能力。戰後清冊才顯示地方防衛軍接管或繳獲M-84坦克、裝甲車、火砲、卡車及大量彈藥；這些裝備並非在十日戰鬥第一天便配給每個基層單位。
kitsEn: At the first contact on 7 July, the JNA could bring into action M-84 main battle tanks, BVP M-80 armored personnel carriers, Yugoslav M-60P wheeled armored personnel carriers, 152 mm M-84 howitzers, 130 mm M-30 field guns, 105 mm M-44 howitzers, and 120 mm M-62 mortars. Its infantry primarily used Zastava M-70, M-76, and M-77 rifles, together with M-48/66 rifles, RPG-7 launchers, 9K14 Malyutka and 9K11 T-3 anti-tank guided missiles, while 9K33 Osa surface-to-air missiles protected important routes and concentrations of armor. The Slovenian TO initially could rely reliably on rifles, light machine guns, CZ-75 pistols, RPG-7s, and a limited number of anti-tank weapons. Its M-80 armored vehicles and artillery had to be supplemented from occupied JNA barracks, depots, and materiel recovered on the front lines. The JNA also had MiG-21 reconnaissance and combat aircraft and Mi-8 helicopters available for operations or standby, whereas Slovenia initially lacked an integrated air-surveillance, air-defense, and aviation-maintenance system. Postwar inventories showed that the TO had taken over or captured M-84 tanks, armored vehicles, artillery, trucks, and substantial ammunition stocks; these assets were not issued to every基层 unit on the first day of fighting.
tactics: 七月七日拂曉，聯邦軍以所屬步兵營、摩托化營、坦克排與工兵分隊，同時沿高速公路、鐵路和山區支線進入。其首要目標是控制兵營、通訊所、彈藥庫、橋頭與機場，並切斷各支部隊的聯繫，而非一次直取盧比安納。西南戰線的皮夫卡（Pivka）最為兇險：從波斯托伊納（Postojna）方向沿拉基特尼克（Rakitnik）隘口下行的裝甲縱隊，在狹窄路段被迫拉長；步兵下車清除路障時遭RPG-7、9K14反戰車武器和後方砲火打擊。聯邦軍雖進入部分市區，地方防衛軍隨後以營級反擊迫使它退出主要陣地。在扎格萊布至盧比安納公路上的克什科（Krško）與布雷日采（Brežice）方向，裝甲推進也受到阻滯。里布尼察（Ribnica）、伊德里亞（Idrija）、武澤尼察（Vuzenica）和阿伊多夫什契納（Ajdovščina）戰線則由地方防衛軍逐點抵抗與反擊。到七月中旬，聯邦軍改為固守兵營、機場和交通點，進行空中偵察與局部攻擊；地方防衛軍則在采列（Celje）、馬里博爾（Maribor）和盧比安納周邊圍困孤立據點，奪取裝備。克羅埃西亞前線的部署限制若干燃料與彈藥運輸，聯邦軍因而已難以維持原有的分散部署。
tacticsEn: Before dawn on 7 July, JNA infantry battalions, motorized companies, tank platoons, and engineer detachments entered simultaneously along highways, railways, and secondary mountain routes. Their immediate objectives were to control barracks, communications stations, ammunition depots, bridgeheads, and airfields while severing the links between subordinate formations, rather than attempting a single direct assault on Ljubljana. The southwestern front at Pivka was the most severe. An armored column descending from Postojna through the Rakitnik pass had to stretch out on a narrow section, and dismounted infantry clearing roadblocks came under RPG-7 fire, 9K14 anti-tank guided missiles, and artillery from rear positions. Although JNA forces entered part of the town, a battalion-level TO counterattack forced them out of the principal positions. Along the Zagreb-Ljubljana road, armored advance was also checked at Krško and Brežice. At Ribnica, Idrija, Vuzenica, and Ajdovščina, local TO resistance and counterattacks disrupted the JNA's attempts to secure individual positions. By the middle of July, the JNA had shifted to holding barracks, airfields, and transport nodes while conducting aerial reconnaissance and local attacks. The TO surrounded isolated positions around Celje, Maribor, and Ljubljana and seized their equipment. The deployment on the Croatian front restricted several fuel and ammunition routes, making the JNA's previously dispersed posture increasingly difficult to sustain.
data: 時間線可按下列節點核對：六月廿五日，斯洛維尼亞宣布獨立；六月底至七月初，地方防衛軍完成動員，聯邦軍則陸續調整第十四軍及其他部隊；七月六日，聯邦軍發出最後通牒；七月七日拂曉，雙方在前線開火，十日戰爭由此開始。七月八日至九日，皮夫卡、克什科、里布尼察與阿伊多夫什契納方向的戰鬥最密集。七月十日至十二日，聯邦軍加強空中偵察與側翼行動，地方防衛軍在西部戰線反擊，而克羅埃西亞前線吸走更多聯邦軍單位。七月十三日至十五日，采列、馬里博爾與盧比安納周邊的孤立據點相繼失守或撤收，聯邦軍的指揮與補給線更加分散。七月十六日至十七日，主要正面交火逐漸停止；七月十八日三方代表在布里奧尼簽署協議，十九日起執行停火與撤軍安排，聯邦軍主力於七月下旬離開斯洛維尼亞，十月後地方防衛軍完成正式整編。常見研究把斯方可用作戰兵力概估為約一萬二千至一萬六千人；聯邦軍在戰區的總兵力為數萬人，但因部分部隊拒絕作戰及另一些被牽制於克羅埃西亞，實際投入程度較低。傷亡總數因早期公報、作戰回報與後來司法材料的分類不同，本文不列無法交叉核對的精確數字。
dataEn: The chronology can be checked against the following sequence. Slovenia declared independence on 25 June. From late June into early July, the Territorial Defence completed its mobilization while the JNA reorganized the 14th Army Corps and other formations. On 6 July, the JNA issued its final ultimatum, and fighting began before dawn on 7 July, marking the start of the Ten-Day War. The fighting was densest at Pivka, Krško, Ribnica, and Ajdovščina between 8 and 9 July. From 10 to 12 July, the JNA increased aerial reconnaissance and flanking operations, the TO counterattacked on the western front, and the Croatian front absorbed additional JNA units. Between 13 and 15 July, isolated positions around Celje, Maribor, and Ljubljana were evacuated, surrendered, or captured, further fragmenting JNA command and supply lines. Principal front-line fire diminished on 16 and 17 July. Representatives of the three parties signed the Brioni Agreement on 18 July, and the cease-fire and withdrawal arrangements began on 19 July. The main body of the JNA left Slovenia later in July, and the TO was formally reorganized after October. Common studies estimate the usable Slovenian combat force at roughly 12,000 to 16,000 personnel. The JNA's theater-wide force numbered several tens of thousands, although fewer were actually engaged because some units refused to fight and others were tied down in Croatia. Casualty totals varied between early press statements, operational reports, and later legal records, so this account does not provide an unverified precise figure.
cause: 戰爭的直接背景是南斯拉夫聯邦制度在政治、軍事與財政上的同步破裂。1990年選舉後，斯洛維尼亞新政府要求以邦聯方式保留共同國防、外交及部分經濟制度，塞爾維亞方面則主張維持中央集權的統一國家；聯邦主席團、表決程序與軍隊指揮權因此頻頻陷入僵局。另一項爭議是財政分配：斯洛維尼亞的銀行儲備仍存放於貝爾格萊德的聯邦金融機構，各共和國對外債、關稅、貨幣及聯邦軍費的分擔也沒有共同方案。一九九一年六月七日布里奧尼會談未能解決軍隊指揮與國家權力問題，斯洛維尼亞遂於六月二十五日正式宣布獨立。聯邦軍主張地方防衛軍在法律上屬於聯邦軍制， 向斯方提出解散及繳械要求；地方防衛軍拒絕後，邊境接管、兵營控制與武裝繳收便成為直接衝突點。七月六日的最後通牒未能阻止對方，翌日越境接管與雙方開火遂把政治僵局轉成戰役。
causeEn: The immediate background was the simultaneous breakdown of Yugoslavia's political, military, and financial structures. Following the 1990 elections, Slovenia's new government sought a confederal arrangement that would preserve common defense, foreign affairs, and part of the economic system, while Serbia favored a centralized unitary state. Federal presidency procedures, voting arrangements, and command over the armed forces consequently became trapped in repeated deadlock. Financial distribution was another dispute: Slovenian bank savings remained in federal financial institutions in Belgrade, and the republics had no common settlement for foreign debt, customs, currency, or the cost of the federal army. The Brioni meeting on 7 June 1991 failed to resolve military command and state authority, and Slovenia formally declared independence on 25 June. The JNA maintained that the TO legally remained within the federal military system and demanded its dissolution and disarmament. After the TO refused, border seizures, control of barracks, and attempts to recover weapons became direct points of collision. The ultimatum of 6 July failed to halt the other side, so cross-border operations and mutual gunfire on the following day converted the political deadlock into a military campaign.
impact: 這場戰爭首先顯示聯邦軍無法依靠單一中央命令維持多民族部隊的協同：部分斯洛維尼亞籍官兵拒絕作戰或脫離原建制，而第十四軍仍能以龐大裝甲力量形成局部優勢，但無法長期控制所有兵營與交通點。地方防衛軍則從占領和繳獲的聯邦軍倉庫取得坦克、裝甲運兵車、火砲、卡車與彈藥，戰後成為斯洛維尼亞武裝力量的主要裝備基礎；這些裝備仍須經過維修、接收與重新編組，並非立刻形成完整作戰能力。政治上，斯洛維尼亞政府的實際控制和邊境局勢獲得確認，聯邦解體程序由爭議進入不可逆階段。戰略上，聯邦軍被牽制於克羅埃西亞，斯洛維尼亞戰線的損失直接影響後續克羅埃西亞戰事；波斯尼亞於一九九二年走向脫離聯邦，也受到整體崩解的連鎖影響。歐洲共同體的觀察與布里奧尼式談判則成為各方處理軍隊撤退、戰俘和裝備清點的外交框架。斯洛維尼亞在二〇〇四年加入歐盟與北約，則是這段軍事經歷留下的長期制度結果。
impactEn: The war first demonstrated that the federal army could not maintain cohesion among its multiethnic formations through a single central command. Some Slovenian personnel refused to fight or left their original units, although the 14th Army Corps could still create a local armored advantage. It could not, however, retain every barracks and transport junction for long. The TO obtained tanks, armored personnel carriers, artillery, trucks, and ammunition from occupied and captured JNA depots, creating the principal equipment base for the future Slovenian armed forces. These assets still required maintenance, transfer, and reorganization and did not immediately constitute a fully operational force. Politically, the Slovenian government and its territorial control were confirmed, and the dissolution of Yugoslavia moved from contested discussion toward an irreversible process. Strategically, the JNA was drawn into Croatia, and losses on the Slovenian front directly affected the subsequent Croatian war. Bosnia's movement toward separation from the federation in 1992 was another consequence of the broader collapse. European Community observation and negotiations of the Brioni type provided a diplomatic framework for troop withdrawal, prisoners, and equipment inventories. Slovenia's accession to the European Union and NATO in 2004 was the longer-term institutional outcome of this military experience.
result: 七月十八日簽署的布里奧尼協議確認停火，要求聯邦軍在約定期限內撤出斯洛維尼亞，交換戰俘，並由有關各方點交與清點被扣裝備。七月十九日起安排逐步執行，至七月下旬聯邦軍主力離開；由於聯邦解體及後續分配，斯洛維尼亞並非把所占裝備全部原封不動交還，也沒有把軍區內所有設備悉數帶走，而是按清冊接收部分當地庫存、車輛與保障設施。戰爭結束時，聯邦軍原定的解除地方防衛軍任務並未完成，斯方完整保存了指揮體系和作戰兵力，斯洛維尼亞的實際控制沒有改變；聯邦軍也未在戰場上被殲滅，而是以建制撤退保留了後來在克羅埃西亞及其他戰線使用的人員與經驗。結果不是雙方同歸於盡，而是斯洛維尼亞獲得軍事獨立、聯邦軍退出該共和國，地方防衛軍隨後改組為斯洛維尼亞武裝力量，聯邦軍則把重心轉向克羅埃西亞並重建以塞爾維亞人為核心的部隊。從七月七日到七月十七日，這場有明確開始、戰鬥高潮、停火協議與軍隊撤離的戰爭，就此結束。
resultEn: The Brioni Agreement signed on 18 July confirmed the cease-fire, required the JNA to withdraw from Slovenia within the agreed period, provided for the release of prisoners, and ordered joint inventories and transfer of seized equipment. The arrangements began to take effect on 19 July, and the main body of the JNA had left by late July. Following the dissolution of Yugoslavia and subsequent allocation, Slovenia did not return every captured item unchanged and did not remove every item from the military districts. It received part of the local stocks, vehicles, and support installations under the inventories. At the end of the war, the JNA had failed to disarm the TO, while Slovenia preserved its command structure and combat force and retained effective control over its territory. The JNA was not destroyed on the battlefield; it withdrew as an organized force and retained the personnel and experience later used in Croatia and elsewhere. The result was therefore not mutual annihilation. Slovenia obtained military and political independence, the JNA left the republic, the TO was reorganized into the Slovenian Armed Forces, and the federal army shifted its center of gravity toward Croatia while rebuilding around formations composed primarily of Serbian personnel. Beginning on 7 July and ending on 17 July, this war with a definite opening, major combat phase, cease-fire agreement, and military withdrawal was thereby brought to a close.
